ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white (approximately 85% of surface) vs. low-intensity black perimeter (approximately 15% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous white region across central and proximal lobes; distinct low-intensity black band along the entire trailing edge; sparse dark micro-speckling localized near the median notch and left-distal region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate 65-degree interior angle; shallow bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-10 pixels; highest density of jagged peaks located on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white-on-black clusters at both the far-left and far-right distal tips, indicating calcified barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected thin, dark horizontal pixel disruptions on the lower-center of the right lobe and faint diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; small dark indentation on the left-lobe trailing edge approx. 1/3 distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'check-mark' pigmentation pattern located approximately 15 pixels to the right of the median notch.
